title.en: Chapter 1 — The Porter and the Sailor

book_meta.work: The Seven Voyages of Sindbad, from ألف ليلة وليلة
book_meta.author: traditional

sentences.ar: ببغداد، كان في حمّال فقير اسمه السندباد.
sentences.en: In Baghdad there was a poor porter named Sindbad.

sentences.ar: بيوم حر، قعد يرتاح قدام بيت كبير.
sentences.en: On a hot day, he sat resting in front of a big house.
He heard music and laughter from inside.

sentences.ar: قال بصوت عالي: ليش هاد غني وأنا تعبان؟
sentences.en: He said out loud: why is this man rich and I am worn out?
The owner of the house heard him and came out to him.

sentences.ar: قال له: أنا كمان اسمي السندباد.
sentences.en: He said to him: my name is Sindbad too.
And I did not get my money easily.

sentences.ar: أدخل واقعد، وبحكي لك سبع رحلات.
sentences.en: Come in and sit, and I will tell you seven voyages.
